considerations: Requires forwarded Cisco Expressway process, file or forensic logs that retain paths in Activity or Message. Ordinary call and session logs are unlikely to contain them.

Review both artifact types on the same appliance and contrast them with approved maintenance. F6 reports the numbered directories as a possible ARTEX link. Directory naming alone does not attribute activity to ARTEX.
These are post-compromise artifacts from one incident. Corroborate with appliance evidence, the cluster inventory, and the Cisco PSIRT advisory.
description: Find the shared-memory package path and numbered working-directory pattern that F6 observed on compromised Cisco Expressway appliances.

evidence.claim: F6 found Python packages staged in shared memory and numbered working directories under /mnt/harddisk/ on compromised Cisco Expressway appliances. The investigators report the naming pattern as a possible ARTEX link.
evidence.location: Post-compromise Python tooling and working-directory findings

expected_output: One row per CEF event with the matched path and the accompanying device or network context.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Python package staging on an Expressway appliance together with numbered working directories can identify a post-compromise pattern in one CVE-2026-76466 case.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Cisco Expressway Post-Compromise Python Staging

1.json:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceProduct contains "Expressway" or (DeviceVendor =~ "Cisco" and Activity contains "Expressway")
| extend EventText = strcat(Activity, " ", Message)
| extend MatchedArtifact = extract(@"(/dev/shm/pylibs|/mnt/harddisk/i[0-9]{4})(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]|$)", 1, EventText)
| where isnotempty(MatchedArtifact)
| extend ArtifactType = iff(MatchedArtifact == "/dev/shm/pylibs", "Shared-memory package staging", "Numbered working directory")
| project TimeGenerated, MatchedArtifact, ArtifactType, DeviceProduct, DestinationHostName, DestinationIP, SourceIP, Activity, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
